description: This source file defines the singleton `AppDatabase` class responsible for initializing, managing, and migrating the SQLite database used in the expense tracker app. It includes schema creation, migration handling, seeding default data, and database configuration. The class heavily utilizes the `sqflite` package for database operations and the `path_provider` for platform-specific directory management.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for database initialization, schema creation, migrations, seeding, and providing access to the SQLite database instance.

methods.name: AppDatabase.db
methods.description: Getter for the database instance, throws error if not initialized.

methods.name: AppDatabase.init
methods.description: Initializes the database, sets up schema, migrations, and seeding.

methods.name: AppDatabase._createV1Schema
methods.description: Creates initial database schema for version 1.

methods.name: AppDatabase._seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds default categories, budgets, and sample transactions if the database is empty.

methods.name: AppDatabase.close
methods.description: Closes the database connection if open.
